title: feat(metadata-protocol, spec): a publish whose registry refused an object answers published_unregistered naming it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D75mRNRrsy6GfiJD9q7La4j)_
Fixes #33277
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: semantic

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:发布整个应用(publish-drafts)时,如果运行时注册表拒收了某个对象,返回不再说「published」,而是新的 `published_unregistered`(`success: false`),并在 `unregistered[]` 里点名这些对象,沿用 #33005 的规则码 `object-registry-refused`。
- 为什么改:按 #33005 的裁决「D 先告警,A 后续跟上」,这是 A:程序化调用方(托管云的 AI 搭建)以前看到「发布成功」就去灌示例数据,结果报找不到表。
- 风险与回滚:新增枚举值,注册表全部接受时返回逐字节不变;应用可见性翻转和控制台的提示保持现状(待裁决)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts`(outcome 推导)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`(翻转白名单,新值保持翻转)、`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`(契约)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol-publish-drafts-advisories.test.ts`,预期 14 个用例全绿,含 `[#33277]` 四个。
- 需要你做的:裁决两件事——新值是否继续触发应用可见性翻转,以及控制台对它是否继续显示「发布成功」(本 PR 均保持现状)。

## What changes

- **Spec** (`PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema`): `outcome` gains `published_unregistered`; the response gains optional `unregistered: [{ type, name, rule: 'object-registry-refused' }]`, present if and only if the outcome is `published_unregistered`. `success` stays exactly `outcome === 'published'`, so it is false on the new value. Describes updated; reference docs, `authorable-surface/api.json` and the strictness counts regenerated. One ADR-0087 semantic entry for major 18 (`publish-drafts-outcome-published-unregistered`), because a caller branching on `success` or `outcome` now takes a different branch for the same server event.
- **Producer** (`publishPackageDrafts`, metadata-protocol): each object whose registry write-through was refused (the #33005 `registryRefused` receipt) is collected in publish order; the batch answers `published_unregistered`, `success: false`, `unregistered[]`. Nothing else moves: the drafts landed and stay live, every object is still in `published[]` with its warning, `failed[]` stays empty, and commit, seeds, probes and receipts are unchanged. Return types in `protocol-history-and-publish.ts` and `protocol.ts` widened.
- **Runtime flip** (`PUBLISH_OUTCOMES_THAT_FLIP`): `published_unregistered` is added, so the ADR-0045 visibility flip and the `metadata:reloaded` announce run exactly as they did when this answer read `published`. Kept as the status quo pending a ruling (below).
- **Client SDK**: the `packages.publishDrafts` docblock no longer says `success: false` on a 200 means nothing landed; it names the three non-success outcomes.
- **Console** (`ui/packages/app-shell`): Studio's publish, the package sheet, Home's Publish all and the AI chat card treated every `success: false` as a failed publish. Each now reads `published_unregistered` as it read the `published` answer the server gave for this before: the refused object's `object-registry-refused` warning still reaches the author through the client's advisory sink, and no caller reports "Action failed" / "Publish failed" for drafts that landed.

## Tests

- `protocol-publish-drafts-advisories.test.ts` (the shared harness): a new `[#33277]` describe pins the refused object named in `unregistered[]` with `published_unregistered` / `success: false` in both publish orders (refused object first and second), two refused objects named in publish order, and a CONTROL that a batch the registry takes whole still answers `published`, `success: true`, with no `unregistered` key. The #33005 case no longer pins `outcome: 'published'`.
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts`: the new value and key parse and round-trip; an entry with an unknown rule or no rule is refused; the vocabulary stays closed.
- `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.test.ts`: the flip still runs after `published_unregistered` (status-quo pin).
- UI: one case each in `PackagesPage.publishRefusal-11922`, `usePublishAllDrafts.refusal-11922`, `AiChatPage.publishAdvisoryReachesAuthor` and `StudioDesignSurface.publishCount-11807`.
- Ablation (once, on the negative pin, after the fix was committed): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the `unregistered.push(...)` line with a no-op (anchor 1 to 0, blob 8035b04df7e5 to 78b920f646cd); the pin file went to 3 failed / 11 passed, exactly the three negative `[#33277]` cases, CONTROL and the #33005 cases green; restored to blob 8035b04df7e5 equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `./protocol.js` from `src`, so no rebuild was needed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Open choice 1, the visibility flip.** `published_unregistered` still flips `_unpublished` apps (status quo: this answer used to read `published`). Alternative: drop it from the allow-list so an app whose object is not served stays hidden until a re-publish. Listed for a ruling; not changed here.
- **Open choice 2, the console's presentation.** The console keeps showing a successful publish plus the object's warning toast (the presentation ruled for #33005). Alternative: a distinct "published, but N objects are not served" message. Listed for a ruling; not changed here.
- **The card's premise detail:** `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts` does not switch on the outcome (it returns a 2xx unexamined and only emits advisories); the switches are in the four `app-shell` callers above, which this PR adapts.
- **Hosted cloud (outside this repo):** the AI build path must stop or retry before seeding on `published_unregistered`, keyed on `unregistered[]` or the `object-registry-refused` rule. Cloud already ships a bounded retry for the seed race; it should now branch on the outcome instead.
- **Not in this card:** the single-item doors (`publishMetaItem`, a publish-mode save) still answer success with the warning on `advisories`; the other write-through callers #33005's report listed stay warn-only.
- Shared files with #33276 (now merged into this branch): `protocol-history-and-publish.ts`, `protocol.ts`, `protocol.zod.ts`, `packages.ts`, the advisories test, `http-dispatcher.test.ts`; the merge was clean and every suite below was re-run on the merged head.

## Verification

Premise measured first, at `origin/main` ba35dfd782 (producer file restored from that commit, blob 884d24a1313b): a publish with the registry refusing `ticket` answered `{"success":true,"outcome":"published","publishedCount":2,"failedCount":0}` with `ticket` carrying `object-registry-refused`, in both publish orders. At this branch: `{"success":false,"outcome":"published_unregistered",...,"unregistered":[...]}` in both orders.

- `@objectstack/spec` `src/api/protocol.test.ts` + `src/migrations/`: Test Files 6 passed; Tests 451 passed.
- `@objectstack/runtime` `http-dispatcher.test.ts`, `packages-publish-drafts-change-note.integration.test.ts`, `packages-publish-drafts-response-conformance.test.ts`: Test Files 3 passed; Tests 275 passed.
- `@objectstack/objectql` `publish-package-drafts-response-conformance.test.ts`: 16 passed.

</details>

Exit 0 before the merge: `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:docs`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:durability-log-level`; eslint `--no-inline-config` on the nine touched package files and eslint on the four UI files (0 errors). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 12 of 123 derived families run locally, 111 left to CI by declared narrowing (the verify lock was held 3h20m by another run).

NOT MEASURED locally: app-shell `type-check` (needs every `@object-ui/*` dist built; Type Check UI owns it); the `check:test-typecheck` leg of runtime and client typecheck (their main `tsc --noEmit` passed; the test layer reported errors in test files this diff does not touch, which import packages not built here).
